notes: Squeek Wars Testnet season. GameRules supplies immutable economy tables; SeedLedger records daily work checkpoints and nontransferable SEED balances; Clans tracks founder-invited membership, support eligibility and ranking counters; Army handles troops, movements, combat, champions and camps; Villages is the canonical player entry point and helper-module namespace. Army and Villages share the same GameRules, SeedLedger and Clans instances. SeedLedger alone has an owner, explicitly supplied by $owner, whose authority is limited to proposing, applying or cancelling a 72-hour timelocked repoint of the Core and NFT read endpoints, or renouncing ownership. Initial endpoints are the approved SqueekCore and Squeek ERC-721 addresses. Constructors are nonpayable and require no initialization calls. No fees, payouts, launch token, pool or deployment funding. Source publication, signed artifact linkage, independent review, admission and deployment are handled by the subsequent services.
